next.reason: 1985 GR6: after the USE procedure, if the I-O status 'does not indicate a critical input-output error', control returns 'to the next executable statement following the input-output statement'; if critical, 'the implementor determines what action is taken'. §2023:14.9.49.4 GR7, the rule for format 1 USE (the only format a 1985 program writes): 'control is returned to an implicit CONTINUE statement following the input-output statement whose execution caused the exception' unless the status indicates a fatal EC-I-O condition, when 'the implementor determines what action is taken as described in 9.1.13, I-O status'. 1985 'critical' (status 3x, 4x, implementor 9x) and 2023 'fatal' name the same class for every 1985 status. GR12 applies only when exception-name-1 or -2 begins with EC-I-O (format 3), so it carries no part of this rule. Same.
